healthcare-agent-free-plan-production.title: The free plan is for evaluation and development
healthcare-agent-free-plan-production.body: This production estimate uses the free healthcare agent plan. Microsoft describes it as an evaluation and development plan with a lower request limit, so real use belongs on the pay-as-you-go agent plan.

citation.source: Healthcare agent service billing rates and management
citation.quote: The free tier is available for evaluation and development purposes.
